description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusTenantManagementAdapter' which acts as a base class for handling tenant management requests received via Vert.x event bus. It routes incoming messages to specific tenant management operations such as create, get, update, and delete, and provides common functionality and error handling for these operations.

classes.name: EventBusTenantManagementAdapter
classes.description: Provides support for receiving service invocation messages via Vert.x event bus and routing them to specific tenant management operations such as create, get, update, delete, and unsupported custom operations. It manages span creation for tracing, payload validation, default field augmentation, and error handling.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Routes incoming event bus message to the appropriate tenant management operation handler (create, get, update, delete, or custom) based on the operation specified in the message.

methods.name: isValidRequestPayload
methods.description: Validates the payload of the request message by attempting to map it to a Tenant class and checking its validity.

methods.name: addNotPresentFieldsWithDefaultValuesForTenant
methods.description: Adds default values for optional fields not present in tenant payload, such as 'enabled' and adapter-specific fields.

methods.name: addNotPresentFieldsWithDefaultValuesForAdapter
methods.description: Adds default values for adapter fields like 'enabled' and 'device-authentication-required' if they are missing.

methods.name: processCustomTenantMessage
methods.description: Handles custom or unsupported tenant management messages. Default implementation returns a failed future with a 400 Bad Request error.
